recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: skeptic whispers about whether automation tightens timelines or just retrains the bottleneck
local silicon and rented models priced like neighbors on the same curb
native calm until plaintext insists on bubbling through
late may light stretching afternoons along a brisk, glass-clear shoreline
spring air cool at dawn before the day climbs toward warmer highs
sunrise sliding earlier than bedtime habits remember

composer-2-fast.concept: A dawn-orbit commuter ring where inbound idea nodes ignite when touched exactly on house-kick flashes; you ride the stutter tightening every loop.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: on-beat tap to tag luminous nodes slipping around a halo track
composer-2-fast.session_hook: one clean revolution clears the night-queue bar and sprays confetti shaders
composer-2-fast.escalation: ghost echoes duplicate nodes and BPM micro-stops shrink the forgiving window
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: orange-teal aurora wires over a noir bay grid

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: You run a microscopic foundry tipping chrome spheres labeled edge vs api into kinetic scales; wrong bins tilt the beam and avalanche raw tokens.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: angled flick arcs that bank spheres into trays before the beam tips
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: three balanced pours snap locks with deep bass bloom
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: heavier alloy balls roll in sideways and ramps ice over
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: brushed aluminum UI with coolant vapor trails

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Sketch a glowing leash between Shortcut bubbles, GH Action chips, and a pocket phone orb without slicing through static doubt fields spawned by headline noise.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: single continuous path draw with occlusion and timeout
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: closed circuit wakes a tiny swarm of bots that reorganize clutter
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: static scribbles regenerate on segments you skim too fast
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: blueprint gel ink on butcher paper overlays

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: A one-screen suitcase puzzle: genre patches flip, shuffle, then must be zipped back into diagonal harmony before the dreamy pop haze fades.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: peek-flip reveals then sliding tile align to latent gradient
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: tap to peek, swipe to slide rows
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: perfect alignment blooms a holographic cassette loop
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: dummy tiles imitate color families mid-round
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: pastel CMYK swirl like folded album foil
